name: Revideo (Motion Canvas fork)
purpose: Programmatic video framework (TSX generator functions, Vite build). Evaluated as a math/algorithm animation engine and not adopted.

installation.instructions: Not installed in the workspace. A global CLI (0.11.0) once existed on the Mac host, wired into nothing.

compatibility.notes: Its own headless-Chrome renderer and bundler: a second copy of what HyperFrames does.

security.notes: npm install and bundler at build time.

approval_evidence: Rejected in specs/motion-graphics-evolution-report.md section 5.2 and again 2026-11-24 (docs/visual-engines.md): duplicates HyperFrames + GSAP + SVG, adds a TSX/Vite toolchain, and upstream activity slowed after its lead contributor left in 2025 (github.com/midrender/revideo issue 356).
